title: Portfolio VaR and expected shortfall for rare defaults
prompt: Losses are positive for losses and negative for gains. VaR at alpha is inf{x: P(loss<=x)>=alpha}; ES is the mean of the worst 1-alpha probability mass, taking only the necessary fraction of any boundary atom. Two independent obligors each default with probability .04 over the horizon. Each default causes100 USD million loss, with no recovery uncertainty. Report each single-name95% VaR, portfolio95% VaR and ES, and whether VaR is subadditive for this particular pair (portfolio VaR<=sum of name VaRs).

outputs.name: var_subadditive_here
outputs.description: True iff the stated subadditivity inequality holds for this pair.
